blocks.head: alt UserX is not near any device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt A ticket of the device was issued more than 2 time units ago

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ...) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ...) > $ deviceA 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (randomStr('Secret', N)) .

eq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((FreshSecret , CurrentTime)) , ...) , ....) > $ deviceA 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (FreshSecret) 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((randomStr('Secret', N) , CurrentTime) , ..) , ...) , ....) > .

ceq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ...) , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA | (deviceA) 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ...) , ....) , .....) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) if Issued == CurrentTime .

eq < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : Secrets , ..) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secrets , Secret) , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceA ; Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ..) , 'owners' : nils , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceA ; Secret) 
= < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ..) , 'owners' : (UserX) , ...) , ....) > .

eq < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (deviceA ; Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ..) , 'owners' : (Owner , ...) , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (deviceA ; Secret) 
= < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ..) , 'owners' : (Owner , UserX , ...) , ....) , .....) > .

ceq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ...) , ....) , .....) > 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : nils , ....) , .....) > if CurrentTime - Issued > 2 .

=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .
